 Next Week on XBOX: New Games for October 26 to 30
 Will Fulton, XBOX Wire Editor 
 October 23, 2026 · 18 min read 
 Welcome to Next Week on XBOX! In this weekly feature we cover all the games coming soon to XBOX Series X|S, XBOX One, XBOX on PC, and Game Pass! Get more details on these upcoming games below and click their profiles for further info (release dates subject to change). Let’s jump in! 
 The Séance of Blake Manor
 Raw Fury
 ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 
 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 
 Get it now 
 The Séance of Blake Manor – October 27 
 Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere 
 It is October 28th, 1897, and Private Investigator Declan Ward arrives at Blake Manor to find a missing woman. What he finds is the Grand Séance and a group of mystics who have gathered from all corners of the world – waiting for All Hallow’s Eve, the night when the veil between worlds is thinnest. The night to tear down the barrier and speak to the dead. Interview and interrogate your suspects, keep a record of all evidence, motivations, and clues in your journal, and confront them about their motivations when you’re certain of your deductions. Uncover the truth about Blake Manor and the mysterious séance that has brought everyone together.
 Mouthwashing
 CRITICAL REFLEX
 ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 
 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 
 $12.99 
 Pre-order 
 Mouthwashing – October 29 
 XBOX Play Anywhere 
 Mouthwashing is a first-person horror game following the dying crew of a shipwrecked space freighter. Who could have known what good ol’ Captain Curly was capable of? Guess he thought his crew dying alongside him was only right. But some men can’t even kill themselves properly. Maimed, limbless and unable to speak, but alive, Curly is now at the mercy of the crew he has doomed to a slow death.
 The Wolf Among Us Remastered
 Telltale
 ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 
 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 
 Get it now 
 The Wolf Among Us Remastered – October 29 
 Fairy tales are real. Murder is just the beginning. Step back into Fabletown in The Wolf Among Us Remastered – the definitive edition of Telltale’s acclaimed noir narrative thriller inspired by DC’s award-winning Fables comic series. Fully remastered with enhanced visuals and modern presentation, this definitive edition brings Bigby Wolf’s first investigation to life with greater atmosphere, immersion, and detail than ever before – honoring the original experience while introducing Fabletown to a new generation of players.
 Queen's Domain
 Future Friends Games
 ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 
 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 
 $19.99 
 $16.99 
 Pre-order 
 Queen’s Domain – October 30 
 Queen’s Domain is a retro-fantasy action RPG. Washed up on the shores of the Isle of Neasied, you set out to find your father and uncover the dark heart of this mysterious isle.  Wield the Legendary Holy Sword Endu to take flight from platform to platform, and discover an interconnected, labyrinthine world where secrets and dangers lurk around every corner. 
 Scramble Knights Online (Game Preview)
 Funktronic Labs
 ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 
 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 
 Get it now 
 Scramble Knights Online (Game Preview) – October 26 
 Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere 
 Welcome to Scramble Knights Online , an MMO-lite adventure! Embark together with friends on bite-sized, Zelda-inspired quests in the shared online kingdom of Terracott! Venture across an archipelago filled with dangerous enemies, quaint towns, puzzling dungeons, and challenges suited for a knight-in-training.
 Terrible Lizards
 Digital Pajamas
 ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 
 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 
 Get it now 
 Terrible Lizards – October 29 
 Game Pass / Smart Delivery / XBOX Play Anywhere 
 Something is very wrong at Dalton’s Dinos, the once must-see Route 66 roadside attraction baking under the New Mexico sun. The staff have vanished, but a mysterious voice on the telephone you find in the attraction begs you for help to find a missing child. You’d leave… if your car hadn’t died miles from anywhere. It’s 1992. No cell phones. No rideshares. No help coming, and you’ll soon find that you are not alone inside the attraction.
 Ayasa: Shadows of Silence
 Aya Games
 ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 
 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 
 Get it now 
 Ayasa: Shadows of Silence – October 26 
 Step into the eerie world of Ayasa , a dark tale that blends quests, horror, and puzzles into a haunting journey. Without a single spoken word, the story is told through pantomime, surreal imagery, and a soundtrack composed by Komitas. You will navigate six symbolic lands Faith, Hope, Love, Greed, Indifference, and Betrayal—each corrupted by darkness. Every choice you make, every act of compassion or indifference, may lead to an unexpected ending. Will you restore balance or become the very force you sought to defeat?
 PAO PAO (Game Preview)
 Dreland Enterprises
 ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 
 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 
 Get it now 
 PAO PAO – October 26 
 Explore a lively town where every day brings something new. Meet quirky characters, discover cozy little spots and landmarks, gather resources in the wild, or simply wander around and see what’s happening. With changing weather, seasons and a full day-night cycle, PAO PAO is always a little different.
 Bao Bao's Cozy Cleaning Services
 Destroyer Doggo 
 ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 
 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 
 Get it now 
 Bao Bao’s Cozy Cleaning Services – October 27 
 XBOX Play Anywhere 
 Welcome to Bao Bao’s Cozy Cleaning Services , where things don’t need to be perfect — just a little cleaner, a little calmer, and a little more you. Whether you’re curled up with a podcast or just need something peaceful to help the world feel quieter, this gentle 2D pressure washing game is here for you. No timers, no stress, just pastel pixel art, soft sounds, and the satisfying swish of clean water.
 Bloom Busters
 UBrothers
 ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 
 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 
 Get it now 
 Bloom Busters – October 27 
 Smart Delivery / XBOX Play Anywhere 
 Bloomland is under attack. A toxic infestation has twisted its gardens and filled them with cheeky mutated creatures – and Jimmy and Jessie are ready to clean up the mess. Bloom Busters is a frantic, old-school action arcade adventure with a distinctive isometric perspective. Play solo or team up in two-player local co-op as you bash and blast through handcrafted levels. Master wild weapons ranging from the trusty Fly Swatter and Grandpa’s Club to the gooey Slime Gun.
 Cozy Radiation Cleaner
 SilverSet Studios
 ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 
 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 
 Get it now 
 Cozy Radiation Cleaner – October 27 
 Cozy Radiation Cleaner is a relaxing open-world clean-up adventure set in a quiet, abandoned wasteland. Grab your radiation detector, follow the crackle and track down 180 radioactive objects hidden across 18 regions – from misty pine groves and salt flats to the eerie Silent Reactor. Every find is added to your collection, a growing catalogue of the strange things the old world left behind.
 Dog Man: Bark in Action
 Mindscape
 ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 
 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 
 Get it now 
 Dog Man: Bark in Action – October 27 
 Smart Delivery 
 Join Dog Man and his Supa Buddies for a supa-new adventure! A comic-book style game packed with action, humor, boss fights, and ability-granting gadgets. Play as 10 different characters from the comics, each with unique powers. A hero is needed! Dr. Scum has set up Hypno Screens around the city, mind-controlling the innocent townsfolk. Now it’s up to Dog Man – part Dog, part Man- to fight back against Dr. Scum and all his minions. Defeat Dr. Scum, save your friends, and rescue the city!
 Farming Simulator 25: Beans & Alpacas Edition
 GIANTS Software
 ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 
 2090 
 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 
 $59.99 
 $47.99 
 Pre-order 
 Farming Simulator 25: Beans & Alpacas Edition – October 27 
 Farming Simulator 25: Beans & Alpacas Edition bundles both the acclaimed main game and the Beans & Alpacas Expansion. Enjoy 4 maps, 400+ machines, over 150 authentic brands, and new crops, animals, production chains and gameplay additions. Build a farm along winding rivers and historic grain elevators in North America, surrounded by ponds in Central Europe, in a lush East Asian landscape filled with rice paddies, or in Catuaí – a South America-inspired region where coffee plantations, red soil and dense greenery shape the land that’s the star of the Beans & Alpacas Expansion.
 Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy
 Stormind Games, Soft Source 
 ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 
 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 
 Get it now 
 Remothered: Red Nun’s Legacy – October 27 
 XBOX Play Anywhere 
 Your daughter has been kidnapped. In the trilogy’s final chapter, enter a nightmare to save her, survive what hunts you, and uncover the Red Nun’s truth through retrocognition, mirror abilities and moth manipulation. A modern return to classic survival horror with an Italian neo-giallo twist.
 Sneaky Purr (Xbox Series)
 Afil Games
 ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 
 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 
 Get it now 
 Sneaky Purr – October 27 
 Get ready for a sneaky adventure in Sneaky Purr ! Control Bill, a mischievous cat and expert little thief, and help him steal all the food pouches before making his way back to the exit of each level. But be careful: escaping with the loot can be much harder than it looks! Bill moves in four directions, but once he starts moving, he slides continuously until he hits an obstacle. Carefully plan every move, avoid security cameras, and think about your route there and back before you act. After all, grabbing the food is only half the job!
 Treasure Tiger
 Take IT Studio! sp. z o. o.
 ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 
 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 
 Get it now 
 Treasure Tiger – October 27 
 Smart Delivery 
 You’ve got five nights to strike it rich and save your future. All you have to do is spin, survive, and keep the windows shut. Treasure Tiger is out there — grinning, watching, waiting. He says it’s all about luck… but he’s not here to play fair.
 Fall Adventure
 Corvo
 ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 
 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 
 Get it now 
 Fall Adventure – October 28 
 Fall Adventure is a 2D pixel art platformer where you must find all the magical orbs to progress. As you descend deeper, the caves become larger and more challenging. All you have is a dash that keeps you in the air for a brief moment, allowing you to reach otherwise inaccessible areas throughout the levels.
 Fallen City Brawl
 Eastasiasoft Limited
 ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 
 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 
 Get it now 
 Fallen City Brawl – October 28 
 Smart Delivery / XBOX Play Anywhere 
 Brawl through the city in hard-hitting pixel art style inspired by arcade classics! As a brutal battle for control of Fallen City’s criminal underworld rages, four strangers join forces to survive and reclaim the streets! With a ferocious wolf at their sides, these unlikely allies will face impossible odds. Along the way, motivations and past lives will collide, further testing their loyalty as well as their fighting skills. Only by binding together can they reach the final showdown that will decide who lives and who falls.
 Gennady
 Sobaka Studio LLP
 ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 
 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 
 $19.99 
 Pre-order 
 Gennady – October 28 
 Smart Delivery / XBOX Play Anywhere 
 Remember that dream where you find yourself on a crowded bus wearing nothing but your underwear? Well, this isn’t a bus — and it’s not a dream either! The blinding light fades, revealing a grim alien meat factory where you must break through compressed biomass with your own body — not to pay the fare, but to survive this dynamic roguelike platformer!
 House Builder 2
 FreeMind S.A.
 ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 
 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 
 Get it now 
 House Builder 2 – October 28 
 In House Builder 2 , you build your dream structures in a vibrant, open-world low-poly environment! Purchase materials for your work, load them up, and head off to diverse tasks in the ultimate building adventure!
 Karate Survivor
 Alawar
 ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 
 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 
 Get it now 
 Karate Survivor – October 28 
 Smart Delivery / XBOX Play Anywhere 
 Step into the shoes of a martial arts master in a thrilling survival-like roguelite inspired by action movies of the ‘80s. Use the environment and improvised weapons, master new techniques, and create devastating combos to fight off relentless goons and bandits! Karate Survivor delivers intense, fast-paced combat where improvisation and creativity are key to surviving the streets.
 The Last Case
 SOFTPLAY S.R.L
 ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 
 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 
 $9.99 
 $7.99 
 Pre-order 
 The Last Case – October 28 
 Smart Delivery / XBOX Play Anywhere 
 Step into the shoes of a police officer investigating the mysterious disappearance of children. Enter the twisted world of a dangerous mind and uncover the truth. See everything through a body camera. Every moment is recorded and later reviewed at the station to teach rookies how a real pro handles a case.
 Platypus Steps (Xbox Series)
 Afil Games
 ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 
 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 
 Get it now 
 Platypus Steps – October 28 
 Get ready for an adventure full of creativity and strategy in Platypus Steps ! Help an adorable baby platypus reach the cookie jar by carefully planning the path it needs to follow. Observe the environment, choose the right elements, and build a safe route to reach the objective! In each level, you begin in planning mode, observing the character’s position, the obstacles, and all the available possibilities. Use the cursor to select and place elements such as springs, wind, and platforms, creating the perfect path for the platypus. When you’re satisfied with your plan, press Play and watch your strategy come to life!
 Primal Planet
 Pretty Soon
 ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 
 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 
 Get it now 
 Primal Planet – October 28 
 XBOX Play Anywhere 
 Primal Planet is a solo developed metroidvania that combines survival and crafting elements with a pixel-perfect aesthetic and an action-packed story, and it’s all taking place on a lush planet filled with dinosaurs. Embark on a thrilling journey as you follow the gripping tale of a cave dweller fighting to protect his family. Survive a brutal T-Rex attack and uncover a narrative blending the wild with intriguing sci-fi twists. Forge unexpected alliances as you unravel the truth behind an alien presence.
 SULFUR
 Copyright by Perfect Random AB. All rights reserved.
 ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 
 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 
 Get it now 
 SULFUR – October 28 
 Smart Delivery 
 SULFUR is a roguelike FPS with fast-paced gunplay, cooking mechanics, and hard choices. Explore hostile zones, fight unpredictable enemies, and loot everything in your power. Modify your weapons, stash your valuables, and cook strange meals to survive just a bit longer.
 Beyond The Evil
 QUByte Interactive
 ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 
 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 
 Get it now 
 Beyond The Evil – October 29 
 Get ready for an immersive experience of mystery and suspense. In Beyond The Evil , you take on the role of Detective Gary Nephew during one of the most unsettling investigations of his career. Explore an isolated estate full of secrets and solve challenging puzzles to uncover the sinister experiments that threaten the world. With no combat mechanics, the gameplay focuses on thorough exploration of the environment, collecting clues, and solving problems using pure logic. Find keys, unlock safes, and discover the whereabouts of the Juniper siblings before it’s too late. Every decision brings you closer to the terrifying conclusion of this gripping story.
 Candy Shop Simulator
 Games Incubator S.A.
 ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 
 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 
 $9.99 
 $8.99 
 Pre-order 
 Candy Shop Simulator – October 29 
 Step into the sweet world of confectionery and build the candy shop of your dreams! Create delicious pastries, chocolates, gummies, and other tasty treats, then stock your shelves and welcome eager customers. Manage every aspect of your business, from pricing and inventory to expanding your store with new products and equipment. Experiment with recipes, unlock fresh opportunities, and grow your small neighborhood shop into a thriving candy empire.
 The Cat in the Hat: Rainy Day Mayhem
 Outright Games Ltd.
 ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 
 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 
 $39.99 
 Pre-order 
 The Cat in the Hat: Rainy Day Mayhem – October 29 
 Smart Delivery / XBOX Play Anywhere 
 The Cat in the Hat once said, “It is fun to have fun, but you have to know how.” Everyone from the mischievous Dr. Seuss classic is here. Become smart and steady Sally, energetic wild card Johnny, cause double the trouble as Thing 1 & Thing 2 or be cheerful Little Cat A. And of course, the chaos conductor, The Cat in the Hat and anxiously wise Fish will be there to help, on this zany ride.
 Choice of Life: Floors
 Sobaka Studio LLP
 ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 
 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 
 $5.99 
 Pre-order 
 Choice of Life: Floors – October 29 
 Smart Delivery / XBOX Play Anywhere 
 To find yourself in a world of your own nightmares, you only need to step into the wrong elevator. Use the items you find, fight the creatures of your mind, embrace the absurdity of your situation, and decide: will you escape this nightmare, or drown in it forever? A dark story told with irony and humor, heightening both the absurdity of the events and the fragility of the human mind. Sometimes, laughing at horror is the only way to cope.
 Choice of Life: Samosbor
 Sobaka Studio LLP
 ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 
 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 
 $4.99 
 Pre-order 
 Choice of Life: Samosbor – October 29 
 Smart Delivery / XBOX Play Anywhere 
 The legendary Choice of Life franchise returns in a new game! The gray concrete walls of the living cell, closing the hermetic door at the sound of a siren – all this is commonplace in Gigastructure. Everything here goes its way, until the block is isolated in search of a secret object…
 Croc 2 Kingdom of the Gobbos
 Argonaut Games
 ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 
 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 
 Get it now 
 Croc 2 Kingdom of the Gobbos – October 29 
 Croc 2 Kingdom of the Gobbos is the sequel to the multi-million selling classic, Croc Legend of the Gobbos . The night before Croc’s next adventure begins, the inventor Gobbo witnesses the Dantinis resurrecting Baron Dante, and is taken prisoner for seeing too much. Back on the beach at Gobbo Valley, Croc is playing when he spots a bottle washed up in the sand. Inside is a message revealing that his birth parents are searching for him. He sets off for the mainland to find them, but the journey soon becomes a showdown, as Baron Dante vows revenge against the humble little crocodile who once defeated him.
 Curse of Resthaven
 Digital Bandidos
 ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 
 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 
 Get it now 
 Curse of Resthaven – October 29 
 Smart Delivery 
 Resthaven is cursed. Your niece has vanished. And in seven days, the island will be destroyed . Curse of Resthaven is a single-player narrative roguelite where investigation, town management, trading, deck building, and branching expeditions combine into a dark mystery of survival and consequence. Take command of the cursed island colony of Resthaven after your niece disappears on the eve of catastrophe. Govern the town, interrogate suspicious locals, trade with visiting merchants, upgrade vital businesses, and decide who — or what — to trust as the island’s secrets begin to surface.
 HELLBOUND INC
 Seashell Studio
 ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 
 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 
 Get it now 
 HELLBOUND INC – October 29 
 HELLBOUND INC is a rage-inducing precision platformer where you play as an undead courier trapped in a fulfillment center recently purchased by Satan himself. Navigate rooms filled with spikes, flame jets, demonic machinery, and collapsing platforms. Push crates, flip switches, activate conveyor belts, and time your jumps to get each delivery to its destination. Every area is a tightly designed challenge that tests both your reflexes and your problem-solving skills.
 Hunting Simulator 3
 Nacon
 ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 
 7 
 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 
 $49.99 
 Pre-order 
 Hunting Simulator 3 – October 29 
 Set off to deepest Colorado, or untamed outback of Texas, each with dozens of wild species to hunt. In these ever-changing ecosystems, each animal reacts to what you do, each individual ages over time, can reproduce and exhibits true-to-life behaviour thanks to our unique “SimFauna” system. The game’s immersive soundscape and dynamic weather plunge you into a variety of natural habitats, teeming with wildlife.
 HYPERVIOLENT
 Fulqrum Publishing
 ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 
 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 
 Get it now 
 HYPERVIOLENT – October 29 
 HYPERVIOLENT is a brutal, old-school FPS in the style of classic sprite-based 3D games from the 1990s – but think more System Shock , less DOOM . After responding to a distress signal from Commodus Asteroid 27-C, a remote mining colony, you find yourself in the midst of an outbreak of violence among its inhabitants. You must unravel the secrets of the asteroid and the evil hidden deep within its mines as you seek an answer to the madness within its complex corridors.
 Joe & Mac Retro Collection
 Red Art Games
 ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 
 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 
 $19.99 
 $17.99 
 Pre-order 
 Joe & Mac Retro Collection – October 29 
 Grab your hammer, the Stone Age is back and bigger than ever! For the first time, three legendary adventures from the Joe & Mac universe are united in a single collection. Step back in time and join your favorite cavemen in their wildest escapades through jungle mayhem, fighting dinos, and stone-age fun.
 Love: Fall in Death
 SNR Interactive
 ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 
 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 
 Get it now 
 Love: Fall in Death – October 29 
 An FMV interactive romantic comedy where your choices, timing, and luck shape every scene. Make decisions, roll the dice, and guide Kutay through a night that can turn into love or total chaos. As the story unfolds, Kutay might discover things about himself, confront unexpected emotions, and realize that sometimes people are far more complicated than they seem. He could end up in a fight with strangers, caught between two powerful feelings, or screaming his head off. Sometimes he can’t take his eyes off someone; other times, he’s risking it all.
 My Life: Zoo Vet
 Markt+Technik Verlag GmbH
 ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 
 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 
 $19.99 
 Pre-order 
 My Life: Zoo Vet – October 29 
 Smart Delivery / XBOX Play Anywhere 
 Many exciting tasks await you in the zoo, and some of the cute residents need your help. From clumsy young animals to curious penguins and powerful elephants – they all need nursing back to health! Examine the patients carefully, figure out what’s wrong, and give them the treatments they need. Pack up your vet’s bag and off you go – they’re already expecting you! Claim your patch, plant your crops, and stake your territory before your rivals do. Every seed you sow could be a decision play it safe with a steady harvest, or gamble on a high-risk, high-reward crop that could change everything… or just let your friends do all the hard work and steal their stuff too.
 ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 
 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 
 Get it now 
 Planted! – October 29 
 Planted!  is a horticultural combat party game where gardens are arenas, plants become weapons, and the gap between “tending your crops” and “launching them at your opponents” is smaller than you’d think.
 The Transference
 JanduSoft
 ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 
 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 
 $12.49 
 $9.99 
 Pre-order 
 The Transference – October 29 
 The Transference is a first-person narrative escape-room thriller set in northern Andalusia, Spain, in the late 1990s. You play as Marcos, who wakes up trapped inside his own home without knowing how or why. The doors and windows have been boarded up from the inside, which means whoever sealed the house may still be there with you.
 Train Yard Builder
 Ultimate Games S.A.
 ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 
 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 
 $19.99 
 $17.99 
 Pre-order 
 Train Yard Builder – October 29 
 Enter the world of Train Yard Builder and customize your railway to your heart’s content. Work with different models of trains and wagons, control them the way you want, and use modeler tools to unleash your creativity.
 The Zibbo Show
 Tessera Studios
 ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 
 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 
 Get it now 
 The Zibbo Show – October 29 
 XBOX Play Anywhere 
 The lights are on. The audience is going crazy. And tonight, YOU are the star of the show! Progress through 12 rounds of increasingly dangerous opponents, build a new strategy every run, and face Zibbo himself in the in the grand finale! If you make it that far. You and your opponent each have a 3×3 board and nine dice. Take turns placing one die at a time. Matching values in a column multiplies your score, and placing the right dice opposite an enemy column destroys their dice. Every placement is a decision full of luck, strategy, and the occasional regret. The crowd loves it either way!
 The Abjuration Stand
 Brainium Games
 ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ 
 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 
 Get it now
